name: tabstudio
description: Tab Studio (AI Guitar Tab Studio): сайт, десктоп (Tauri), iOS/Android (Capacitor) из одного кода

scripts.serve:web: npm run build:web && npx --yes http-server platforms/web/dist -p 8080 -c-1
scripts.build:desktop: node scripts/build-app.mjs desktop && cd platforms/desktop && npm run tauri build
scripts.dev:desktop: node scripts/build-app.mjs desktop && cd platforms/desktop && npm run tauri dev
scripts.build:mobile: node scripts/build-app.mjs mobile && cd platforms/mobile && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run build:mobile && cd platforms/mobile && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run build:mobile && cd platforms/mobile && npx cap open android
